required.quote: All optometrists licensed in this state shall be required to take annual courses of study in subjects relating to the practice of the profession of optometry.

insurance_required.quote: Have at least $1,000,000 of professional liability insurance coverage.

definition_quote.value: the employment of any methods or means, other than surgery, for the diagnosis and treatment of any optical defect, deficiency, deformity, or disease of the human eye, adnexa and eyelids; diagnosis and treatment of any visual or muscular anomaly of the visual system; adaptation or prescribing of spectacle lenses, contact lenses, prisms or ocular exercises; prescribing, administering or dispensing of pharmaceutical agents; application, prescribing, or removal of FDA approved medical devices; and diagnosis of acute angle closure glaucoma.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of optometry" means the employment of any methods or means, other than surgery, for the:

value: prescribing of spectacle lenses, contact lenses, prisms or ocular exercises
prescribing, administering or dispensing of pharmaceutical agents
application, prescribing, or removal of FDA approved medical devices
diagnosis of acute angle closure glaucoma and emergency care
methods_authorized.quote: the employment of any methods or means, other than surgery, for the: (a) Diagnosis and treatment of any optical defect, deficiency, deformity, or disease of the human eye, adnexa and eyelids.

drug_authority.value: Licensed optometrists certified under RSA 327:6-a may prescribe, administer, and dispense pharmaceutical agents including topical and oral medications; anti-glaucoma agents with additional certification; vaccines; and emergency anaphylaxis treatment by injection. Schedule I and II controlled substances are prohibited. Class III and IV controlled substances may be authorized via the formulary.
drug_authority.quote: Prescribing, administering or dispensing of pharmaceutical agents.

surgery_prohibited.quote: "Practice of optometry" means the employment of any methods or means, other than surgery

surgery_definition.value: any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical means, including use of lasers for therapeutic and photorefractive purposes, ionizing radiation, therapeutic ultrasound, or medication administered by injection
surgery_definition.quote: "Surgery" means any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical means. Surgical procedures shall include the use of lasers for therapeutic and photorefractive purposes, ionizing radiation, therapeutic ultrasound, or medication administered by injection, provided that the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye, adnexa or eyelid shall not be considered a surgical procedure prohibited by this chapter.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye, adnexa or eyelid shall not be considered a surgical procedure prohibited by this chapter

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: Anti-glaucoma agents provided that an optometrist may dispense or prescribe such agents if the optometrist has met the requirements of RSA 327:6-c.

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: Diphenhydramine, epinephrine, or an equivalent medication administered by injection or other administration route to counter anaphylaxis or anaphylactic reaction.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: Adaptation or prescribing of spectacle lenses, contact lenses, prisms or ocular exercises for the correction, relief or aid of the visual functions.

immunization_authority.quote: Vaccines by injection to individuals 18 years of age or older.

value: Class III and IV controlled substances may be authorized via the formulary
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: administer, prescribe or dispense any pharmaceutical product designated as a schedule I or schedule II controlled substance under RSA 318-B:1-a

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: Antibiotics, sulfonomides, and combinations thereof, which are topically applied or orally administered to treat or alleviate the effects of disease or abnormal conditions of the human eye, adnexa, and eyelids, or structures posterior to the iris, approved pursuant to RSA 327:6-a, VI.

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: Only licensed optometrists who have successfully completed examinations on pharmacological substances and other treatments of diseases of the eye, adnexa and eyelids, who have met acceptable standards of education and professional competence as determined by the board, and who hold current certification in cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR), shall be authorized to use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry.

value: licensed optometrist with pharmaceutical agent (TPA) certification

specialty_certification_types.quote: Upon certification to treat glaucoma patients pursuant to RSA 327:6-c, the office shall issue a license to the optometrist with a "tpa/g" certification.

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: an approved course shall be given by an accredited school or college of optometry in the United States and shall consist of a minimum of 105 hours, of which a minimum of 25 hours shall be in direct clinical training.

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: a minimum of 25 hours shall be in direct clinical training

referral_to_physician_required.quote: Upon such diagnosis, an optometrist may administer emergency care and shall immediately refer the patient to an ophthalmologist.
